items.name: Full Steps in Brest 2016

venue.name: [Brest Regional Centre of Olympic Reserve for Rowing](http://www.rowing.brest.by/)

items.information: Registration will be closed on July, 31 or when we reach 110 competitors. Registration fee is from 5 to 25 BYN depending on the date of a registration and on the chosen events. There is only pre-payment systemt. 4x4x4 Cube: Blindfolded, 5x5x5 Cube: Blindfolded are tentative. Other events are guaranteed. Please see the website for more details.

items.information: The entrance fee for this competition will be: For competitors: €8 per day or €15 for the weekend. Competitors only registered for 3x3 get a €3 discount. There's a limit of 45 competitors.
